reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by A11Y Project (https://www.a11yproject.com/).
Technology stack: css, javascript, svg.
Component specification: 先看 Content 第一条：左边能勾选，展开后是 WCAG 3.1.5。
Key visual & interaction patterns: 跳转到主内容链接、页内锚点、回到顶部按钮.
Visual details from source observation: 我们进去先停在首页那张黑卡片：紫色大字把 a11y 拆成 accessibility。要干活就点 Checklist，滚到 Content 第一条「用平实语言」——左边是真能勾的框，展开后是 WCAG 3.1.5 和分享链接。About 写明这是社区维护的开源站，源码在 GitHub。适合拿去逐项审页面的人；页上自己说了，勾完不等于已经无障碍。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: 站点源码许可按官方仓库文件记录。
